full_judgment:
9. In Title Suit 218 of 2010 the case of defendant 6 is that admittedly Mahtab Uddin was owner in possession in D marked plot measuring 10(ten) katha. He sold 5(five) katha of D plot from the smith to defendant 6 and the rest 5(five) katha of north side was sold to plaintiff. Defendant 6 erected homestead. Five katha is equivalent to 0.0828 acres. But in the city survey khatian 456 only 0.0722 acres were recorded and the remaining 0.0103 acres were wrongly recorded in the name of the plaintiff in city survey khatians 3504 and 650. Defendant 6 left 285 sq. ft. from his northern portion amicably for convenience of movement on the understanding that plaintiff would not enter into such left out land at the time of construction. But on 28-8- 20.10 plaintiff amalgamated such left out land with his land. The city survey khatians 3504 and 650 were also wrongly prepared in the name of plaintiff by inserting that 285 sq. ft. equivalent to 0.0103 acres. Hence the suit was filed for recovering 0.0103 acres and correction of record. 

 17. Mr Md Mozammel Hoque, learned Advocate appearing on behalf of defendant 6 in both revision and appeal takes us through the materials On record and submits that the Courts below committed error of law resulting in an error in such decree occasioning failure of justice in failing to consider the material evidence on record affecting the merit and touching the root of the case. The Court also erred in law in coming to its wrong conclusion without assigning proper reason. The Court failed to appreciate that plaintiff led contradictoty evidence and neither cause of action nor possession followed by dispossession is proved in evidence. He further submits that Court very enthusiastically granted declaration of title in favour of the plaintiff although such prayer was omitted by subsequent amendment, He also submits that the ex-parte decree passed upon evidence of PW 1. Mezbahul Adam was restored but the suit did not start from that stage as before and Abdul Hai deposed as PW. 1 although Mesbahul Alam was alive thus it violates the provision of Order IX, rule 15 of the Code of Civil Procedure. He candidly submits that since the decree passed in Title suit 591 of 2015 is not in conformity with the sketch map of the schedule to the plaint this suit cannot be decreed under section 51(a) read with Order V11, rule 3, Order XX, rule 6(1), Order XXI, rule 11(2)(j)(i) of the Code without a clear description of the property. He submits that the commissioner's report clearly contradicts the case of the plaintiff and reliance upon such wrong report is unwanted and the same causes failure of justice. He then submits that the inclusion of part of the land of defendant 6 in city survey khatians 3504 and 650 made in the name of plaintiff is apparently wrong and any right if granted by way of amicable arrangement is not legally binding upon the grantor. He finally submits that since plaintiff has evidently failed to prove his case in both revision and appeal the impugned judgments may be interfered with. 

 36. Title of each of the parties by Exhibits 1 and 3 is admitted in this case. Exhibits 1 and 3 contains 5 (five) katha each which is equivalent to 825 ajutangsho, Trial Court found that since defendant 6 admitted that because of earlier understanding between the predecessors of both parties the land measuring 285 sq. ft. was left out by Aziz Khan which is now claimed by defendant 6 after long lapse of time. This finding is wrong. Possession on the basis of mutual understanding does not constitute the same adverse against the real owner. Plaintiff also did not make out any case of ouster, SA and RS records were correctly prepared in the name of defendant 6. But in the city survey khatian 456 only 722 ajutangsho of land instead of 825 ajutangsho which is equivalent to Wive) katha was recorded in the name of defendant 6 and the remaining left out 103 ajutangsho equivalent to 285 sq. ft. was wrongly inserted in city survey khatians 3504 and 650 in the name the plaintiff. Therefore we are of the view that defendant 6 is entitled to have corrected the khatian in his name by inserting 103 ajutangsho land which has been wrongly entered in the khatians belonging to plaintiff.
